scenarios.name: Reveal an off-screen tab when selecting its document

scenario_steps.name: the user opens `Window01.opd` through `Window12.opd` from `fixtures/cad/document-tabs-native/overflow` in order
the tab strip overflows its available width
the tab for `fixtures/cad/document-tabs-native/overflow/Window01.opd` is outside the visible portion of the strip
the user selects that part from the View tab's Switch menu
the tab strip shifts to show its active tab
the part's viewport and model browser are displayed
